## Deinos (CR 3)

A hungry light glows in the eyes of this otherwise normal-looking horse. It neighs at you threateningly, while baring teeth more pointed than usual.  

**XP** 800  
NE Large magical beast  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +8  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 14, flat-footed 11 (+5 Dex, +2 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 33 (2d8+17)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +8, **Will** +3  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft.  
**Melee** bite +7 (1d4+7), 2 hooves +2 (1d6+3)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** hunger frenzy, rending bite (1d4+9)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 20, **Con** 25, **Int** 6, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 24 (28 vs. trip)  
**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Runb  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness.*  
**Skills** Perception +8  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common, Infernal (cannot speak)  


**Special Abilities**



**Hunger Frenzy (Ex)** Once per day when it has not eaten any meat for more than 12 hours, a deinos can enter a blood rage without taking damage. This blood rage lasts until the end of the battle or until it uses its rending bite.  

**Rending Bite (Ex)** Whenever a deinos confirms a critical hit with its bite attack against a corporeal opponent, it can rend the opponent’s flesh, dealing an extra 1d4+9 points of damage.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate plains  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or herd (3–30)  
**Treasure** none
